column3: With respect to the Olive Industrial 4-Pack Mortgage Loan (6.8%), the sole tenant at the Massillon Property, A.R.E. Accessories, LLC, holds a right of first offer under its lease agreement. Pursuant to the terms of the lease agreement, before marketing the Massillon Property for sale, the related borrowers must provide written notice to the sole tenant, who then has 30 days to submit an offer to purchase the Massillon Property. The related borrowers may accept or reject the offer in their sole discretion. If the parties do not agree on the purchase price, the related borrowers may market, contract for and sell the Massillon Property without liability or obligation to the sole tenant, provided that the final purchase price exceeds the sole tenant’s offer. Pursuant to a subordination, non-disturbance and attornment agreement executed in connection with the origination of the Mortgage Loan, the sole tenant waived its right of first offer in connection with a foreclosure, deed-in-lieu of foreclosure or any other taking by the lender.
